name: Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City
short_description: A 737-room midscale Holiday Inn Express in Newport City, Pasay, about 1 km (a 10-minute walk via the Runway Manila bridge) from NAIA Terminal 3.
ai_summary: Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City sits at 1 Jasmin Drive within Resorts World Manila's Newport City complex in Pasay, roughly 1 km -- a 2-minute drive or 10-minute walk via the covered Runway Manila bridge -- from Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3. As a midscale, 737-room property, it is IHG's largest and most budget-oriented Manila hotel in this directory, offering free in-room Wi-Fi, a 24-hour fitness center, guest laundry, on-site parking, and the Great Room restaurant serving Filipino and international breakfast, lunch, and dinner. A September 2024 review by Upgraded Points called it a solid airport-convenient option, praising staff hospitality and runway views from upper-floor rooms while flagging a limited breakfast selection and some worn furnishings. TripAdvisor rates the hotel 3 of 5, reflecting its budget-tier positioning relative to IHG's full-service Manila properties, with recurring guest complaints about the removal of a former airport shuttle (transfers now cost more than a metered taxi or ride-hail) and small, basic rooms. It has no pool, unlike IHG's other Manila properties, but its sheer proximity to NAIA and direct Newport City mall access make it a practical pick for short layovers and early flights.

faqs.question: How close is Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City to the airport?
faqs.answer: It sits about 1 kilometer from NAIA Terminal 3, connected via the covered Runway Manila bridge, making it roughly a 10-minute walk or a 2-minute drive -- one of the closest hotel options to the airport in the entire Metro Manila area.

faqs.question: Does Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City have a pool?
faqs.answer: No -- unlike IHG's full-service Crowne Plaza and Holiday Inn properties in Manila, this midscale Holiday Inn Express does not have a swimming pool, though it offers a 24-hour fitness center, free Wi-Fi, guest laundry, and on-site parking.

faqs.question: Is there an airport shuttle at Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City?
faqs.answer: Guest reviews indicate the hotel has discontinued its complimentary airport shuttle, with paid transfers now costing more than a metered taxi or ride-hail app; given the hotel's roughly 1 km proximity to Terminal 3, most guests simply walk or take a short taxi ride instead.
